placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
M Shed explores the city through the experiences of the people who have lived and worked here. Its harbourside setting makes it easy to combine time in the galleries with a short waterfront walk.

Our family idea: look for a story connected to a place you know, then compare it with somewhere new. Ask children which object they would choose to tell a visitor about Bristol today.
